title: Quantum Rare-Event Estimation for Ising Graphical Models with Belief-Propagation State Preparation
summary: Quantum amplitude estimation can reduce the sampling cost of rare-event probability estimation, but applying it to correlated Ising graphical models is limited by the difficulty of preparing the target distribution and building a practical event oracle. This work explores two approximate strategies for mitigating these challenges. We introduce a sample-free state-preparation method combining loopy belief propagation with the Chow--Liu algorithm.
